en.headline: Police seek domestic helper after HK$206,000 Deep Water Bay theft
en.dek: A resident reported two watches, a tablet and cash missing from a Shouson Hill Road flat on Monday afternoon; no arrest has been made.
body: Police are searching for a 42-year-old domestic helper after valuables worth about HK$206,000 were reported missing from a flat at 7 Shouson Hill Road in Deep Water Bay.

A 47-year-old male resident reported the case at about 4.30pm on Monday. Officers said the missing items were a watch valued at about HK$140,000, another watch valued at about HK$60,000, a tablet computer worth about HK$3,000 and HK$3,000 in cash.
After a preliminary inquiry, police classified the case as theft. It is being handled by the Western District crime investigation team. No one has been arrested, and enquiries are continuing.

zh.headline: 深水灣單位失約20.6萬元財物 警追緙外傭
zh.dek: 壽山村道一個單位周一午后報失兩隻手錶、平板電腦及現金，案件列盜竊，暫未有人被捕。
body: 警方正追緙一名42歲家庭傭工，因深水灣壽山村道7號一個單位報失約值20.6萬元財物。
一名47歲男住戶於星期一下午約4時30分報案。警方指失物包括一隻約值14萬元的手錶、另一隻約值6萬元的手錶、一部約值3,000元的平板電腦，以及3,000元現金。
經初步調查後，案件列作盜竊，交由西區警區刑事調查隊跟進。暫未有人被捕，調查仍然進行。
